A.depoimento:
Today I ordered the recruitment of two spearmen in Lisboa and split our army to seize Santarem and Evora.
The march begins now; we expect to hold both villages by next turn.
A.plano:
First turn: take Santarem and Evora to secure the western flank.
Next turns: reinforce these villages, build spearmen in Lisboa, and push toward Salamanca via Coimbra, then to Madrid, aiming to control the central road network.
After securing the interior, advance east to threaten Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent a knight to capture Tarragona and a spear‑archer force to take Girona, while training two fresh spearmen at Barcelona.
B.plano: Next turn: reinforce the newly taken villages, keep building spearmen, and send scouts toward Zaragoza to open the northern front.

A.depoimento: We attacked the neutral villages of Coimbra, Badajoz, and Faro simultaneously. Santarem's force took Coimbra, while Evora's knights captured Badajoz and its archers seized Faro. All three villages are now under our control with no losses reported.
A.plano: Secure the newly taken villages Coimbra, Badajoz, and Faro. Reinforce them with troops from Lisboa and Evora. Build spearmen in Lisboa to strengthen the western flank. Next, advance from Coimbra to Salamanca, then toward Madrid to dominate the central road network. After controlling the center, push east to threaten the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento:
We seized Castellon, Zaragoza, and Huesca with knights and archers.
We sent Girona's spear and archer to Barcelona for reinforcement.
We trained two new spearmen in Barcelona.
B.plano:
Next turn: garrison Castellon and Zaragoza with spare troops.
Continue building spearmen in Barcelona.
Use arriving troops from Girona to reinforce Barcelona.
Prepare to push further north.

A.depoimento: I launched an assault on Porto with Coimbra’s knight and two archers, while reinforcing Coimbra from Lisboa and Evora. I also built spearmen in Lisboa, Evora, and Santarem to replenish our forces. This sets us up to seize Porto and expand our control.
A.plano: Secure Porto next turn, then use its resources to build archers and knights. From Coimbra, advance to Salamanca and Badajoz, then seize Madrid to control central road. Finally, march east toward Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Moved Zaragoza's knight to Castellon and Huesca's archer to Zaragoza. Ordered two spearmen to be built in Barcelona for reinforcements.
B.plano: Next turn: attack Valencia with Castellon's two knights. Keep Zaragoza defended by the incoming archer. Continue building spearmen in Barcelona for future pushes. Prepare to advance north after securing Valencia.

A.depoimento: I sent spearmen from Lisboa, Santarem, Evora and Coimbra to Sevilha, archers from Faro and Porto to Vigo, and the knight from Porto to Badajoz. I also trained new troops in all villages to replenish forces.
A.plano: Capture Sevilha, Vigo and Badajoz this turn using spearmen and archers. Strengthen Coimbra with incoming troops. Next turn, use Porto's remaining archer and Lisboa's spearmen to take Salamanca and Badajoz's surroundings, then push east toward Barcelona.

B.depoimento: I launched Castellon's two knights to capture Valencia and sent Barcelona's spearmen to take Teruel. Zaragoza's archer marched to Barcelona for reinforcement. I ordered spearmen production in all my villages to rebuild our forces.
B.plano: Next turn: expect Valencia and Teruel to fall; reinforce new villages with fresh spearmen; continue building spearmen everywhere; prepare to push north from Valencia toward Pamplona and Burgos.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent a knight and two spearmen from Coimbra to capture Salamanca, and mobilised spearmen from Lisboa, Santarem and Evora to take Badajoz. I also ordered new spearmen and archers to be built in our villages for the coming push.
A.plano: Hold Badajoz and Salamanca, reinforce them with incoming spearmen. Next turn, build archers in Faro and Porto, then attack Vigo and Sevilha. After securing western neutrals, mass troops and advance toward Madrid and Zaragoza, then push to Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn I trained spearmen at Zaragoza and archers at Barcelona, readying for the next push. My marching spearmen continue toward Teruel, which should fall soon.
B.plano: Next turn: expect Teruel to fall; reinforce new villages with fresh spearmen; continue building spearmen everywhere; prepare to push north from Valencia toward Pamplona and Burgos.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered knights built in our four interior villages and sent two spearmen to bolster the force heading to Salamanca. We hold our current villages and prepare to strike east.
A.plano: Build knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra to prepare for taking Badajoz. Next turn, reinforce the army marching to Salamanca to secure it. After Salamanca falls, use it as a base to produce more knights and advance toward Madrid and Zaragoza, then push to Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Sent strong force to Teruel, small units to Pamplona and Zaragoza, and ordered spearman buildup across all holdings.
B.plano: Next turn: expect Teruel to fall; reinforce new villages with fresh spearmen; continue building spearmen everywhere; prepare to push north from Valencia toward Pamplona and Burgos.

A.depoimento: I ordered knight production in all our western villages and extra spearmen in Faro and Porto. Santarem's knight marches to Badajoz to seize it, while spearmen from Santarem and Coimbra head to Salamanca to prepare for the strike on Madrid.
A.plano: Secure Badajoz with a knight from Santarem, then use Salamanca as a staging ground for a Madrid assault after reinforcing it with spearmen from Santarem and Coimbra. Meanwhile, stockpile knights and spearmen in Faro and Porto for future pushes toward Sevilha and Vigo. After taking Madrid, advance through Toledo and Zaragoza toward the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Statement: Built spearmen in all villages (except Teruel) and two archers in Barcelona. Sent excess troops to reinforce Zaragoza and Teruel, leaving a single garrison in each of our villages. No attacks launched this turn as forces were insufficient for immediate captures.
B.plano: Plan: Build spearmen everywhere and archers in Barcelona. Send excess troops to Zaragoza and Teruel while keeping 1 garrison per village. Avoid attacking neutrals this turn; focus on massing forces for next turn's offense.

A.depoimento: Sent Porto's knights and archer to capture Vigo, and Faro's knights and archer to take Sevilha. Built two spearmen each in Lisboa and Evora to stockpile for upcoming offensives.
A.plano: Secure Vigo and Sevilha this turn to expand our western flank. Reinforce Salamanca with incoming spearmen for a future Madrid assault. Stockpile spearmen in Lisboa and Evora to later launch a Toledo strike via Badajoz. After taking Madrid, push through Toledo and Zaragoza toward the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered an archer built in every one of my villages to strengthen my ranged forces. I dispatched spearmen to capture Madrid and Pamplona, aiming to expand my territory. I held back on Toledo and Murcia, focusing on consolidating power.
B.plano: Build 1 archer in each village to boost future archer count. Send 8 spears from Zaragoza to Madrid and 6 spears each from Zaragoza and Huesca to Pamplona. Avoid attacking Toledo or Murcia this turn due to insufficient local forces; hold current villages and prepare for next-turn reinforcements.

A.depoimento: This turn I fortified Badajoz with fresh spearmen and incoming knights, stocked Porto and Faro with additional troops, and prepared invasion forces for Toledo, Sevilha, and Vigo. Our armies are ready to strike next turn.
A.plano: Secure Toledo, Sevilha, and Vigo in the next two turns to expand our control to 11 villages. Then consolidate garrisons and launch an assault on Madrid via Toledo or Salamanca. After taking Madrid, advance through Burgos and Zaragoza toward the enemy capital Barcelona. Maintain strong defenses on newly captured fronts.

B.depoimento: We constructed archers in eight villages to boost our future firepower. Eleven spearmen marched from Teruel to take Pamplona, expanding our territory. Four spearmen were sent from Zaragoza to reinforce Madrid against the enemy.
B.plano: Capture Pamplona this turn with spearmen from Teruel to gain a new village. Build archers in all feasible villages to increase future archer strength for tougher targets like Salamanca. Send reinforcements from Zaragoza to Madrid to bolster our border defense. Avoid attacking Toledo or Murcia this turn due to insufficient local forces.

B.depoimento: Our forces from Barcelona seized Pamplona, expanding our realm. We sent spearmen from Zaragoza to strengthen Madrid's defenses. Across our villages, we began constructing knights and archers to prepare for tougher battles ahead. The marching army from Teruel will reach Pamplona in two turns to reinforce our new holding.
B.plano: Capture Pamplona with Barcelona's troops this turn. Reinforce Madrid with spearmen from Zaragoza to defend against Salamanca. Build knights and archers in all villages to boost future offensive power. Avoid attacking Toledo or Salamanca this turn due to insufficient force or risk of leaving Madrid undefended.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered a massive recruitment drive: spearmen in Lisboa, Evora, Badajoz, Porto, Salamanca; archers in Santarem, Coimbra, Faro. No troops were moved, focusing on stockpiling for upcoming offensives.
A.plano:
Phase 1: Produce spearmen in Badajoz (4) and Porto (6) and Lisboa (6) to assemble a strong spearman force at Badajoz for an assault on Toledo.
Phase 2: Produce archers in Faro (5), Santarem (6), Coimbra (6) to create archer squads for Sevilha and Vigo.
Phase 3: Keep Salamanca fortified; after capturing neutrals, advance toward Madrid and eventually the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered knight production in eight villages and an archer in Teruel. I sent Zaragoza spearmen to reinforce the Pamplona assault, marched Teruel archers toward Murcia, and reinforced Burgos with spearmen. Existing marches to Pamplona continue.
B.plano: Next turn: expect Pamplona to fall with reinforced spearmen; begin consolidating knights for offense; prepare Murcia attack with Teruel archers arriving in two turns; hold Burgos garrison; avoid premature attacks on Salamanca or Toledo.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in every village and sent reinforcements to the front lines. Archers are being gathered at Salamanca and Badajoz for the upcoming push against Madrid and the neutral towns.
A.plano: Stockpile spearmen at Badajoz and Salamanca while building archers for future assaults. Next turns: capture Toledo and Sevilha from Badajoz, Vigo from Porto, then mass archers at Salamanca to take Madrid. Hold gained villages and expand toward enemy capital.

B.depoimento: This turn I forged knights in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Valencia, and Teruel, and sent veteran knights to Madrid and Pamplona to mass for tomorrow's strikes, while reinforcing Madrid with fresh archers.
B.plano: Next turn: attack Burgos from Pamplona and Toledo from Madrid using concentrated knight forces; hold defenses; continue building knights in interior villages for future offensives; avoid premature attacks on Salamanca.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent a mixed force from Badajoz to take Toledo and Sevilha, and Porto's spearmen to seize Vigo. I built two spearmen in each of my villages to replenish losses. My armies march to strengthen the front lines.
A.plano: Capture Toledo, Sevilha, and Vigo this turn. Next turn, reinforce Badajoz with incoming spearmen and Salamanca with incoming archers. Then mass archers at Salamanca to assault Madrid while holding the newly taken villages. Continue expanding toward Cordoba and Burgos.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent a knight-heavy force from Pamplona to capture Burgos and a mixed spear-knight force from Madrid to take Toledo. I also ordered new knights across my interior villages and bolstered spear and archer numbers where needed. My front advances while my heartland stays secure.
B.plano: Next turn: reinforce Burgos and Toledo with garrisons; continue knight production in interior villages; keep Madrid defended against a possible enemy advance from Salamanca; avoid premature attacks on Salamanca.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered each of my interior villages to train two spearmen each, stockpiling infantry. I sent twenty spearmen from Badajoz to bolster Toledo’s defenses. Five spearmen from Vigo marched to Burgos to capture the weakly held enemy village.
A.plano: Consolidate hold on Toledo, Sevilha, Vigo. Build spearmen in interior villages to stockpile infantry. Reinforce Toledo with Badajoz spearmen to deter the incoming enemy army. Capture Burgos with Vigo spearmen. Next turn, prepare an assault on Cordoba using archers from Salamanca.

A.depoimento: Built seven knights in interior villages to boost elite forces. Sent a mixed detachment from Toledo to seize Cordoba. Reinforced Toledo with troops from Salamanca to secure the home front against enemy reprisals.
A.plano: Capture Cordoba next turn using Toledo forces while reinforcing Toledo with Salamanca troops. Then hold Cordoba and prepare assaults on Teruel and Madrid from Toledo. Simultaneously strengthen Salamanca and Burgos defenses. Over following turns, seize Teruel, Madrid, Burgos, Pamplona and expand east to reach 18 villages held for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: Sent 4 archers from Tarragona to Burgos and 3 knights from Barcelona to Cordoba. Ordered a kingdom‑wide buildup of knights and archers to strengthen our armies for the next push.
B.plano: Capture Burgos and Cordoba to raise held villages to 13. Continue building knights and archers for future assaults on stronger enemy holdings. Avoid overextending; do not attack Salamanca or Toledo until we have sufficient force.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered the construction of spearmen in all interior villages to boost reserves. I sent Toledo's spearmen to assault Teruel and a mixed force from Salamanca to take Madrid. Additionally, I dispatched Sevilla's archers to reinforce Cordoba against the approaching enemy army.
A.plano: Capture Teruel and Madrid this turn using forces from Toledo and Salamanca. Reinforce Cordoba with Sevilla archers to defend against enemy incursions. Build spearmen in inland villages to stockpile for future offensives. Next turn, hold the newly taken villages and prepare assaults on Murcia and Pamplona from Cordoba and Burgos. Continue expanding east to reach 18 villages held for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: This turn we trained additional knights and archers in our villages, and sent reinforcements: three archers from Madrid to Burgos and one archer from Barcelona to Cordoba, to support the ongoing assaults.
B.plano: Next turn we expect to capture Burgos and Cordoba, raising our held villages to 13. We will then focus on building more knights and archers in our interior villages to prepare an assault on Toledo from both Burgos and Cordoba. We will also garrison our new borders to prevent enemy counterattacks.

A.depoimento: This turn I built spearmen in all my villages and sent forces from Toledo to take Cordoba and Teruel. The attacks succeeded, expanding my control to 14 villages. I now prepare to push eastward next turn.
A.plano: Capture Cordoba and Teruel this turn to secure two key border villages. Next turn, reinforce Cordoba and prepare assaults on Madrid and Pamplona from Toledo and Salamanca. Build spearmen in inland villages to stockpile for future offensives. Aim to hold 18 villages by turn 19 and maintain for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: Statement: This turn I built archers in every village to boost our forces, sent archer squads to Burgos and Sevilha, reinforced Cordoba with spears, and repositioned archers from the interior toward the front lines to prepare for upcoming assaults.
B.plano: Plan: Secure Burgos and Sevilha with archer forces next turn, reinforce Cordoba with spears, stockpile archers in interior villages for future Toledo assault. Avoid direct attack on Toledo until we have sufficient numbers. Keep marching archer from Barcelona to Cordoba en route.

A.depoimento: We sent archers and spears to assault Cordoba, dispatched fast knights to bolster Salamanca and Sevilha, and ordered spearmen production across our realms to strengthen our hold.
A.plano: Defend Salamanca and Sevilha against incoming enemy armies. Attack Cordoba with a mixed force of archers and spears to capture it next turn. After securing Cordoba, reinforce it and prepare assaults on Teruel and Madrid from Toledo and Salamanca. Continue building spearmen in all villages to boost defenses and stockpile for future offensives.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent archers from Pamplona to prepare the capture of Burgos, reinforced border villages with archers from the interior, and ordered archers to be built across our realms to stockpile for future offensives.
B.plano: Capture Burgos next turn with archers from Pamplona. Stockpile archers in interior villages for future assaults on Toledo, Salamanca, and Sevilha. Build archers in all villages to increase reserves. Avoid premature attacks on Toledo or Salamanca until we have sufficient archer numbers.

A.depoimento: Built spears across the realm and a knight in Toledo. Launched an assault on Madrid with 3 spearmen and 4 knights from Salamanca, while sending spears from Porto and Badajoz to bolster Salamanca's defenses.
A.plano: Capture Madrid this turn to reach 13 villages. Next turn, reinforce Madrid and Toledo, then attack Cordoba from Toledo with knights. After securing Cordoba, push toward Teruel and Pamplona, aiming to hold 18 villages within two turns.

B.depoimento: We sent four archers from Pamplona to attack Burgos, hoping to seize the enemy outpost. At the same time, we reinforced Teruel, Madrid, and Cordoba with archers from Valencia, Zaragoza, and Murcia, and began building archers in every village to increase our reserves for upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Capture Burgos this turn with archers from Pamplona. Stockpile archers in all interior villages to prepare for future assaults on Toledo, Salamanca, and Sevilha. Reinforce border villages Teruel, Madrid, and Cordoba. Avoid premature attacks on Toledo or Salamanca until we have sufficient archer numbers.

A.depoimento: Built a knight in each of my villages to boost future strength. Sent spears from interior towns to reinforce Salamanca and Toledo, and dispatched knights to Toledo for a forthcoming strike on Teruel. Also prepared spears for upcoming assaults on Madrid and Cordoba.
A.plano: Reinforce Salamanca and Toledo with spears and knights this turn. Next turn, attack Madrid from Salamanca and Cordoba from Toledo with spears, and Teruel from Toledo with knights. After capturing these, consolidate and push toward Pamplona and Zaragoza, aiming to hold 18 villages within two turns after captures.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent elite forces from Pamplona and Teruel to seize Burgos and Toledo, securing our southern flank. I bolstered Madrid and Cordoba with fresh troops from Zaragoza, Murcia, and Huesca. Meanwhile, I ordered villages to produce archers, preparing for the next push toward Salamanca and Sevilha.
B.plano: Capture Burgos and Toledo with Pamplona and Teruel forces. Reinforce Madrid and Cordoba with Zaragoza, Murcia, and Huesca troops. Build archers in all villages to stockpile for future offensives. Avoid attacking Salamanca or Sevilha this turn due to weak surviving garrisons.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained knights and archers in key border towns and shipped spearmen from the interior to fortify Badajoz, Salamanca, Vigo and Sevilha. No attacks were launched as we prepare for a stronger push next turn.
A.plano: Build knights in Badajoz, Salamanca, Sevilha and archers in Vigo to gain counter advantage. Reinforce border villages with spears from interior to strengthen defenses. Next turn, attack Toledo and Madrid with knight-heavy forces, and Burgos and Cordoba with archer/knight mixes. After capturing these, consolidate and push toward Teruel and Pamplona, aiming to hold 18 villages within two turns after captures.
